title: Output is a prefix along a run
statement: Let $tm$ be a multi-tape Turing machine, let $c$ be a configuration on an input word, and let $t,t'\\in\\mathbb{N}$ satisfy $t\\le t'$. The output word after $t$ steps from $c$ is a prefix of the output word after $t'$ steps from $c$.
hypotheses_covered: A configuration on an input word
replaced:
Let $M$ be a deterministic multi-tape Turing machine, let $c$ be any
configuration of $M$, and let $t \le t'$ be natural numbers.  Then the word on
the output tape after running $M$ for $t$ steps from $c$ is a prefix of the
word on the output tape after running $M$ for $t'$ steps from $c$.
